tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Get one timeline entry in full, with the source excerpts that support it. Use it when your user wants detail or evidence for an entry whose id came from list_experience or list_skills; an unknown id returns an error telling you to call list_experience.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the skills of the person with this handle, each with evidence_count and the fact_ids of the entries that back it. Use it to check whether a skill is backed by real experience; pass a fact id to get_experience to see the evidence. The optional query filters skills by name.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_knowledge · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact, preview_my_cv · Destructive: search_knowledge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_knowledge · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact, preview_my_cv · Destructive: search_knowledge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
